title: 1811. Slicing in Banking Interest Calculation
description:
Banking Interest Calculation
50
Medium
Slicing in Banking Interest Calculation
Problem Statement:
Show slicing effect when storing derived object in base container.
Description:
Base Class: Account
   - balance
   - virtual calculateInterest()
Derived Class: FixedDeposit
   - interestRate
   - override calculateInterest()
Requirements:
1. Store FixedDeposit in vector<Account>.
2. Show slicing problem.
3. Fix using vector<Account*>.
4. Display interest in both cases.
Input Format:
Balance
Interest Rate
Output Format:
Interest (Sliced)
Interest (Correct)
